name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success & Renewals Operations | Channel and Reseller Partnerships, Salesforce, Retention
summary: Customer success and sales operations professional with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, built around keeping existing accounts on contract and growing. At Birdeye I ran a reseller channel of 15-20 partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) in Salesforce and retained all but one (~94%). At Fetch & Funnel I worked sales operations, tightening reporting and cutting handoff errors. Across every role I keep CRM records clean and current, so leadership can see where every account stands without asking.

experience.title: Client Success & Revenue Operations — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the client relationship for a portfolio of service businesses, identifying opportunities to expand retainer scope with complementary services.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Architect CRM systems with segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene rules, and validate every data import into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel.
Build automated follow-up and reminder workflows so client deadlines and next steps never depend on memory.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 multi-stakeholder client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each, running QBRs and resolving feedback promptly to protect retention.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a channel of 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K) across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to carry value to their own end customers.
Analyzed partner utilization metrics to flag at-risk accounts early and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Handled 50+ partner activities per day, tracked in Salesforce alongside synced enrichment and routing tools.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ total) while serving as sales team lead, managing workflows in ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Held 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets while managing a high-value account portfolio.
Defined the Salesforce fields required for sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across teams of up to 30.
Managed up to ~25 concurrent accounts in onboarding, keeping each on schedule as primary contact.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct guidance.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
